status: IMPLEMENTATION — formal training not yet launched
research_question: Can REM-Net learn a session calibration token that improves continuous ECG beyond conventional lag+affine calibration, and do Event and Morphology interact positively?
input_protocol: MMECG loso_v2; each source-training and held-out validation record uses its first 20 seconds as paired calibration and sample-disjoint remainder as query
frozen_backbone: B1 full-support continuous checkpoint for the corresponding fold

architecture.R: frozen radar-to-continuous-ECG backbone and its event logits
architecture.M: calibration encoder over paired baseline prediction, reference ECG, and reference derivative; record-mean session token
architecture.E: predicted R/QRS event field gates the continuous residual
architecture.interaction: the morphology token FiLM-modulates residual blocks before event gating
architecture.output: baseline continuous ECG plus identity-initialized residual

factorial_arms.neither: zero calibration token and unit event gate
factorial_arms.event_only: zero calibration token with event gate
factorial_arms.morphology_only: calibration token with unit event gate
factorial_arms.conventional: non-learned session lag+affine control from q1_session_calibrated_continuous_probe

parity: all four learned arms have identical parameters, training records, budget, loss, decoder, and checkpoint rule; switches mask information/pathways without deleting parameters
checkpoint_selection: validation query-only continuous composite; Shape-200 excluded

gate.stage_0: small source-record overfit must reduce continuous loss and produce nonzero residual
gate.stage_1: fold 1 full arm must exceed conventional calibration PCC by >=0.05 without worsening RMSE and R2
gate.stage_2: only then run folds 5/9 factorial; full improves all folds, mean gain over conventional >=0.05, E×M interaction positive

shape200: auxiliary reporting may be added later but is forbidden from loss, checkpoint selection, gate, and headline table
test_policy: development validation only; MMECG test files remain unopened
